notes: Next.js careers page reads GET https://service.upstox.com/content/open/v1/jobs/ with no query parameters (58 API rows, of which the 13 with post_on_careers_page == 1 are rendered). The page has a keyword box ('Search jobs by title, department, or location...') plus Department, Location, Location Type and Work Type checkboxes, all filtering the rendered cards client-side via 'Show Results'; the jobs API accepts no filter parameters.
